candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is Ewing sarcoma, a specific small round cell sarcoma defined by CD99 positivity, pseudo-rosettes, and characteristic morphology. C001 correctly identifies the uterine location and serosal-to-myometrial invasion but stops at the generic parent category 'uterine sarcoma,' omitting the required Ewing sarcoma specificity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the anatomical location and invasion pattern but does not specify the histological subtype (Ewing sarcoma); 'uterine sarcoma' is the parent category encompassing many subtypes

case_quality_flags: Strong IHC support for Ewing sarcoma (CD99+, KIT+, cyclin D1+; keratins, DOG1, synaptophysin, desmin, myogenin all negative); EWSR1 FISH not reported but clinical/morphological/IHC profile is highly characteristic
